description: Erection of single-storey ground floor rear extension to existing outbuilding be used as an office.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The application proposes a new independent office use (Class E). Policy LP33 promotes and protects office space in Central Activity Zones, Town Centre, Local Centres and defined edge of centre sites. Applications for new office development located outside of these identified areas will only be supported where this would not undermine the function of these sequentially preferable locations, as identified through a sequential test. A test has not been submitted alongside this application. Therefore, the development does not comply with Policy LP33 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 2 - By reason of its design, scale and siting the proposed outbuilding would represent an incongruous and dominant addition, making its immediate setting cluttered and overdeveloped. The inappropriate and unsympathetic development would result in harm to the character, appearance and setting of the Nightingale Lane Conservation Area and Grade II listed terrace. The proposal therefore fails to accord with Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, policies LP1 and LP3 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the NPPF (2024).

Reason : 3 - By reason of its design, scale, siting and use, the proposal would be an unneighbourly form of development that would result in a sense of overbearing, loss of daylight/sunlight as well as the potential for unacceptable levels of noise and disturbances to the harm of existing neighbouring residential occupiers. The development is therefore contrary to policies LP2 and LP14 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the NPPF (2024).

Reason : 4 - The application has failed to demonstrate means of suitable access to the proposed office use which can be achieved for all people, including operational and servicing requirements. The application proposal therefore fails to comply with policies LP2 and LP50 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 5 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition further guidance was offered to the applicant by the case officer during the processing of the application to identify amendments to address those elements of the scheme considered unacceptable. However, the necessary amendments to make the application acceptable are substantial and would materially change the development proposal. They would require further consultations to be undertaken prior to determination, which could not take place within the statutory determination period specified by the Department of Communities and Local Government. You are therefore encouraged to consider submission of a fresh application incorporating the material amendments set out below which are necessary to make the scheme acceptable.
